Author: Amit Sharma Bench: Amit Sharma  $~45  * IN THE HIGH COURT OF DELHI AT NEW DELHI  + BAIL APPLN. 75/2023  M. RADHA ..
 Through: Mr. Deepak Prakash, Mr  Kapoor, Mr. Divyangana  Vishnu Priya, Advocate  versus  STATE GOVT OF NCT OF DELHI ..
 Through: Ms. Manjeet Arya, APP   with S.I. Arun Kumar, 
 CORAM:
 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE AMIT SHARMA  ORDER % 21.02.2023

entities.text: HIGH COURT OF DELHI AT NEW DELHI
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
The present application under Section 482 of the Cr.P.C. seeks following prayers:
"a. Allow the present application for grant ad-interim Bail and release the Applicant,
Mrs. M. Radha, on bail in First Information Report No. 429 of 2022 dated 25.11.2022 registered at P.S. Saket, u/s 406/420/120/34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860; and b.
Pass any other and further order as this Honble Court deem fit and proper in the present facts and circumstances of the case."
Learned counsel for the applicant seeks leave to withdraw the present application.

Leave granted.
The application is dismissed as withdrawn and disposed of accordingly.
List on the date already fixed, i.e., 27.02.2023.
